title: A guard's remedy text never reaches the owner
why: The owner asked (page ask ask-mw6pwif5wv, 12:09 CST Nov 7) why guard instructions meant for a session reached his page. The Unvetted remedy text was passed to him as is.
note:
Done check (coordinator pick 1a, 12:26 CST Nov 7): a red test where a lint/report_guard.py Stop block reason carries session-instruction wording; green once each reason opens with one plain owner-safe line and cites decision guard-remedy-not-to-owner, and a second test shows every verdict unchanged. Built in PR #1427 (lint/test_report_guard_remedy.py), with runner 8.
Coordinator pick 12:26 CST: the leak was the Stop-hook block reason from lint/report_guard.py (UNVETTED_REASON plus CORRECTION_TAIL), not a page write. Done check: a red test where a report_guard Stop reason carries session-instruction wording; green once each reason opens with one plain owner-safe line and cites a record for the session's steps; verdicts unchanged. Done: on main by #2046: 35b0a92c8, aefd2101c (coordinator's Explore agent (Sonnet) read of origin/main 0e6509a96, 05:01 CST Nov 10). REOPENED 12:53 CST Nov 13 (retro 12:52 CST; owner 12:52 CST: the guard exists and needs improving): the Hand-off guard (decision guard-remedy-not-to-owner, section "Hand-off guard", HAND_OFF_NO_CITE and the rest; hooks/reply_judge.py also judges rule output-never-hand-off-doable-step) fires only on a reply with a "Why yours" line. The retro's 12:49 paste prompt for Degen pin upgrades had no such line and passed, though a session on this account can attach degen (owner correction 12:50 CST). Fix: also fire on any fenced prompt the owner is told to paste into another session, and accept a cite only when it shows the act is account-bound (a page, a session) rather than a repo a session here can attach. Only sessions and artifacts are per account; git repos are not. Done check: a red test on a reply with a pasted prompt and no "Why yours" line.
